title: The Five Punishments and the Call to Meet God
description: Through the prophet Amos, the Lord reminds Israel of five punishments He has sent: famine, drought, blight and locusts, plague and sword, as well as upheaval like that of Sodom and Gomorrah. After each punishment, the refrain is repeated: "Yet you did not turn to me." Therefore, the solemn call now sounds: "Prepare yourself to meet your God, Israel!"
